item.title: So I Made Our Postmortems Run in CI
item.description: The morning the test failed while passing "Experience is the name everyone gives to their mistakes." - Oscar Wilde, Lady Windermere's Fan A few weeks ago, an automation suite I maintain had one of those weeks. Salesforce journeys, driven end to end with Playwright - create a customer, convert it, book the order, verify what a downstream system received. The unglamorous kind of testing. It started with a run that failed at 96%.
